# Signer RPC commands

<!-- This file is generated by `contrib/devtools/gen-rpc-docs.py`. Do not edit it manually. -->

The `Signer` category of the DeFiChain JSON-RPC interface exposes 1 command. The text below is the help output of the node itself, so it matches the binary that generated this page.

For the complete interface, see the [RPC and CLI reference](../index.md).

## enumeratesigners

```text
enumeratesigners
Returns a list of external signers from -signer.
Signers with duplicate master key fingerprints are skipped.

Result:
{
  "signers" : [          (array of objects) The connected external signers
    {
      "fingerprint" : "hex", (string) The master key fingerprint of the signer
      "name" : "name"          (string) The device name, the model returned by the signer
    }
    ,...
  ]
}

Examples:
> defi-cli enumeratesigners 
> curl --user myusername --data-binary '{"jsonrpc": "1.0", "id":"curltest", "method": "enumeratesigners", "params": [] }' -H 'content-type: text/plain;' http://127.0.0.1:8554/
```
